narrative: YTD revenue is GBP 3.6M below budget. Volume −GBP 2.3M (legacy ceases faster than budget), price +GBP 0.9M (the April rise held), mix, usage and FX −GBP 2.2M. Each effect drills to partner → customer → invoice line.

signals.title: UK PSTN switch-off — January 2027
signals.excerpt: Exchanges moving to stop-sell accelerate legacy ISDN/PSTN ceases; customers must migrate to IP voice (PhoneLine+, Horizon, SIP) or leave.

signals.title: Billing leakage £3.9M a year (0.6% of revenue)
signals.excerpt: 1,840 provisioned-but-unbilled assets in the September billing run, 6,300 lines on a superseded price list, CDR rating errors after the March rate-table update.
